entries.en: to mock, to make fun of; to deceive or toy with someone
entries.notes: Burlar 17世纪义为嘲笑/戏弄；汉字“弄滚”与官话对音均污损（T99），故降为中置信。

entries.zh: 嘲弄并使之陷入迷局、受骗上当
entries.en: to mock and lead someone into confusion/a labyrinth (to entangle in deceit)
entries.notes: laberynto 与滚有損互证尚可，但西语词头本身带[疑]标记，展开依赖推断。

entries.zh: 讥笑、嘲笑（burlar de dientes＝当面嘲笑）
entries.en: to laugh at, to mock openly (lit. mock at the teeth)

entries.zh: 粗俗地嘲弄、恶意的玩笑
entries.en: coarse mockery, crude joking
entries.notes: 粗滚与 burlar pesado 语义贴合，但西语缩写形态与音写有杂项（cùn?），中置信。

entries.zh: 放肆地嘲弄、粗野的玩笑
entries.en: wild/coarse mockery, rude joking
to mock wickedly, bad joking (burlarse/burlar pesado)
entries.notes: 官话对音有[疑:t/f]，“歹滚”与 burlar pesado 贴合，故中置信。

entries.zh: 极其放肆地嘲弄、非常无礼地取笑
entries.en: to mock extremely rudely, to jest shamelessly (burlarse pesadamente)

entries.zh: 拿东西（文件、条款等）给人看以戏弄、逗弄
entries.en: to mock someone by showing him something (papers/letters or terms)
entries.notes: pliegos（文件、条约）带[疑]，马尼拉贸易语境常指契约条款逗弄商人，但材料不足以断定。

entries.en: she-ass, female donkey
to search for, to look for
entries.notes: 尋字与 buscar 清晰对应，但闽南语原稿与官话对音均有污损（T99），降中置信。

entries.en: to search pondering, to ponder/reflect (buscar pensando)
entries.notes: 尋思与 pensar（思考）对应清晰，官话第二字有[疑:sū/sy]。

entries.en: to search looking about, to seek by observing (buscar mirando)
entries.notes: 闽南语原稿 T99 污損，且西语侧仅 buscar. 缩写，语义定位依赖省字与 mirando 推断。

entries.en: to seek and find (buscar y hallar)
entries.notes: 尋見与 buscar y hallar 语义清晰，但闽南语与官话对音均污损（T99），中置信。

entries.zh: 寻找而找不到、寻而不获
entries.en: to seek and not find (buscar y no hallar)
entries.notes: 尋不見与语义贴合，但闽南语与官话对音均污损（T99），中置信。

entries.zh: 找后手、追索余下的（寻找剩余/底牌）
entries.en: to seek what remains over, to track the remainder (buscar lo que sobra)
entries.notes: 尋后手（找接手/后续之人）与 sobra 的对应关系依赖推断，中置信。

entries.zh: 寻找缝隙、找空隙钻进去
entries.en: to seek a crack/gap (to pry open a seam)
entries.notes: 西语词头大面积残缺（ro[残]o del [残]esa），仅能据尋縫与残片推断。

entries.en: to investigate so as to verify, to check (buscar para certificarse)
to inquire and find, to discover by searching (buscar y hallar)
to rummage, to search through (trasegar)
entries.notes: 搜与 trasegar（翻检）贴合，但西语词头带[疑:Trasegar/Trasagar]。

entries.en: to rummage and search about, to search thoroughly
entries.notes: 搜尋与 buscar trasegar 贴合，但闽南语与官话对音均污损（T99），中置信。
